# stable_id|category|genres|premise

wd-p-0627|route|realist,adventure|A cycling guide discovers that a washed-out bridge can be bypassed only through a farm whose owner remembers her previous tour as trespassing. The injured rider cannot wait for formal permission to be arranged.

wd-p-0628|resources|realist,adventure|A film crew stranded on an island has enough fuel to power either a distress transmitter or the pump keeping its boat afloat. The radio operator knows the nearest vessel listens only at scheduled intervals.

wd-p-0629|coordination|realist,adventure|A search team follows a lost child's deliberate trail markers until the trail divides. One branch follows instructions taught at school; the other follows the method the child's parent insists was practiced at home.

wd-p-0630|threshold|speculative,adventure|A cargo airship stays aloft only while its load remains balanced. An urgent passenger transfer changes the balance, and the only movable counterweight is a sealed crate whose owner forbids opening it.

wd-p-0631|repair|realist,adventure|A railway engineer can restart a stalled train by coupling it to a service engine behind it. The coupling maneuver would push the last carriage onto a section of track the inspection crew has not cleared.

wd-p-0632|trust|realist,adventure|A guide recognizes safe drinking water by a plant that has recently spread into contaminated ground. The travelers trust the method because it saved an earlier party, and rejecting it means crossing a dry ridge before night.

wd-p-0633|route|speculative,adventure|A tunnel through a glacier opens only when sunlight strikes both entrances. A rescue team entering at dawn learns that cloud has covered the far side, and retreat would leave the missing party beyond the next freeze.

wd-p-0634|resources|realist,adventure|A mountain hut has a working stove but no dry fuel. The only burnable material is the search map pinned across its wall, including annotations made by the missing group the rescuers hope to reach.

wd-p-0635|coordination|realist,adventure|Two boats must tow a damaged vessel through a narrow channel. Each captain receives a different tide estimate from a reliable source, and neither estimate accounts for the floodwater arriving from upriver.

wd-p-0636|threshold|realist,adventure|A hiking party reaches a pass just before its permit window closes. The return route is unsafe after dark, but crossing would require the least experienced member to lead a section the guide cannot traverse with an injury.

wd-p-0637|repair|speculative,adventure|A rover's wheel can be repaired using a part from its communication mast. Making the journey possible would prevent the stranded team from learning that the planned destination has begun an evacuation.

wd-p-0638|trust|realist,adventure|A storm forces a racing crew to shelter in a competitor's harbor. Their host offers a safe departure route, but using it would reveal the local shortcut on which the host's livelihood depends.

wd-p-0639|route|realist,adventure|A canyon guide finds a ladder removed from the only marked exit. The missing rungs have been used to reinforce a shelter farther downstream, forcing the party to choose between retracing dangerous water and following an unmarked rescue adaptation.

wd-p-0640|resources|speculative,adventure|An underwater vehicle has enough ballast release to surface once. Its pilot finds survivors below a shelf that can be reached only by descending beyond the point from which the automatic ascent was designed to recover.

wd-p-0641|coordination|realist,adventure|A relief team reaches a village where residents have already begun moving supplies along a footpath. Driving the trucks onto the official road would collapse the temporary bridge supporting that local distribution route.

wd-p-0642|threshold|realist,adventure|A sailing trainee must enter a harbor while the navigation lights are out. The instructor's remembered alignment depends on a building recently demolished, and the trainee is the only one who has seen the new shoreline in daylight.

wd-p-0643|repair|realist,adventure|A field team's satellite terminal needs a clear view blocked by a fallen tree. Moving the tree would free the antenna but remove the brace holding their damaged shelter above rising water.

wd-p-0644|trust|speculative,adventure|A rescue drone identifies safe ground by traces of old human activity. On an abandoned world, its preferred landing zone is the site of the accident that caused everyone to leave.

wd-p-0645|route|realist,adventure|A courier must cross a city during a transit shutdown using a paper map printed before new barriers were installed. The only person offering directions helped build the barriers and is trying to leave without being recognized.

wd-p-0646|resources|realist,adventure|A stranded climbing pair can descend together if they cut their rope into shorter lengths. The cuts would remove the only remaining line long enough to reach a third climber reported below them.

wd-p-0647|coordination|speculative,adventure|A convoy's vehicles must cross a magnetic plain in alternating directions to keep their engines charged. A breakdown leaves the remaining drivers unable to move toward the stranded vehicle without first traveling farther away.

wd-p-0648|threshold|realist,adventure|A flood evacuation bus can clear a low bridge only while empty. Its driver must find somewhere safe to leave passengers while repositioning, although the shelters on either side report that they are full.

wd-p-0649|repair|realist,adventure|A small aircraft can take off after a damaged panel is removed. The panel also carries the markings by which the rescue ship has been told to distinguish the aircraft from an unrelated search target.

wd-p-0650|trust|realist,adventure|A guide discovers that a client's expensive navigation device uses an old trail database. The device's confident correction leads toward a collapsed route, while the guide's safe alternative looks like a mistake on every displayed map.

wd-p-0651|route|speculative,adventure|A caravan follows moving patches of shade across an exposed plain. A traveler needing slower progress falls behind the pattern, and saving one person requires persuading the group to surrender the shade everyone was allocated.

wd-p-0652|resources|realist,adventure|A team sheltering after a storm finds a generator with fuel but no starter battery. The available battery powers a medical device, and the mechanic cannot know how long starting will take until the connection is made.

wd-p-0653|coordination|realist,adventure|A coastal rescue depends on a volunteer opening a locked access road. The volunteer has the key but is on the wrong side of the same flooded channel the road was intended to bypass.

wd-p-0654|threshold|speculative,adventure|A station's rescue elevator can carry the crew only if it skips a damaged deck. A survivor signals from that deck using the elevator's own call system, which automatically adds the stop back to the route.

wd-p-0655|repair|realist,adventure|A walking party finds a broken suspension bridge whose remaining cables can support one person. Repairing it from the far side requires sending the person least able to return if the repair fails.

wd-p-0656|trust|realist,adventure|An expedition leader conceals a minor injury to avoid slowing the group. The injury changes the leader's gait enough to invalidate the distance estimates everyone has been using to ration water.

wd-p-0657|route|realist,adventure|A desert convoy's planned water stop is reachable only through a newly fenced property. The owner offers passage if the convoy carries a stranded rival whose presence makes the travelers' destination politically dangerous.

wd-p-0658|resources|speculative,adventure|A spacecraft can survive a radiation burst by turning its storage tanks toward the source. The maneuver moves the rescue hatch away from a nearby capsule whose remaining air is measured in minutes.

wd-p-0659|coordination|realist,adventure|A wildfire crew finds two evacuation routes independently marked safe. One team cleared its road before a wind shift; the other inspected after, and the communication log records both reports at the same time.

wd-p-0660|threshold|realist,adventure|A guide must decide whether to cross a river whose depth is below the official limit. The submerged stones have shifted, making the published depth safe only for people who know a footing no longer visible.

wd-p-0661|repair|speculative,adventure|A habitat's emergency beacon works only while connected to a damaged exterior antenna. Retrieving the antenna would let a waiting rescue craft dock, but would leave later arrivals unable to locate the station.

wd-p-0662|trust|realist,adventure|A rescue volunteer follows a missing runner's training schedule to predict her location. The runner changed plans to accompany someone slower, and every search model assumes she continued pursuing her own target.

wd-p-0663|route|realist,adventure|A rescue team can reach a stranded boat through a private canal. Opening the lock would drain the shallow refuge where another boat has taken shelter, and its occupants cannot be contacted from the control hut.

wd-p-0664|resources|realist,adventure|A team finds a stocked emergency cache sealed by a combination tied to the local weather report. The report is available only through a transmitter powered by the battery inside the cache.

wd-p-0665|coordination|speculative,adventure|Two rescue teams approach a damaged habitat from opposite directions. Each must use the same narrow docking arm to stabilize it, and the automatic system mistakes their combined approach for a collision to avoid.

wd-p-0666|threshold|realist,adventure|A train driver sees a signal permitting passage but recognizes temporary work markings beyond it. Stopping on the grade would prevent restarting without assistance, leaving the passengers exposed to the weather the train was sent to escape.

wd-p-0667|repair|realist,adventure|A boat's steering fails beside a tidal mill. Borrowing its chain would restore steering, but the chain is also securing a temporary footbridge being used to evacuate residents.

wd-p-0668|trust|speculative,adventure|An expedition's guide is a machine trained on successful journeys only. It rejects the survivors' account of a failed route because no return record exists, and the survivors must teach it that absence can be evidence.

wd-p-0669|route|realist,adventure|A hiker finds a shortcut marked by fresh boot prints that match her own. She realizes she has looped through terrain altered by fog, but the pack she left as a marker is no longer where the route requires it.

wd-p-0670|resources|realist,adventure|A group trapped in a mine can signal by hammering a pipe. The pipe also carries the water rising around them, and the pattern loud enough to reach rescuers may break its weakened joint.

wd-p-0671|coordination|speculative,adventure|An orbital rescue requires every survivor to release a tether simultaneously. One suit's clock has drifted, and transmitting a corrected countdown would use the communication channel controlling its failing oxygen supply.

wd-p-0672|threshold|realist,adventure|A ferry operator can complete one more crossing before the channel closes. A late passenger brings information that the supposedly safe landing has been cut off from the road inland.

wd-p-0673|repair|realist,adventure|A rescue vehicle's cooling system can be repaired with water from its emergency tank. The repaired engine will carry the team farther, but the destination's drinking supply was the reason the rescue was requested.

wd-p-0674|trust|realist,adventure|A local guide offers to lead a search through land she is legally barred from entering. The search leader needs her knowledge but must decide whether recording the rescue route would expose her to consequences afterward.

wd-p-0675|route|speculative,adventure|A ship can cross a hazardous field by following another vessel's exact wake. The leading vessel sends a warning that it is being forced onto a course its followers will not have enough fuel to leave.

wd-p-0676|resources|realist,adventure|A climbing group has one tent rated for the coming weather. Making space for a stranger requires leaving equipment outside, including the communication unit whose batteries cannot survive the cold.

wd-p-0677|coordination|realist,adventure|A rescue coordinator learns that two teams are following different people wearing identical donated jackets. Their reports appear to track one erratic traveler, concealing that each person has been moving away from the other's last position.

wd-p-0678|threshold|speculative,adventure|A rescue capsule seals automatically when it reaches safe internal pressure. One passenger's damaged suit keeps venting into the cabin, making the capsule think it is ready before everyone has entered.

wd-p-0679|repair|realist,adventure|A ranger can reopen a blocked trail by cutting a fallen tree. The tree's roots are holding the soil above a shelter where the missing party may have waited out the storm.

wd-p-0680|trust|realist,adventure|A traveler recognizes the warning flags at a river crossing but knows the colors mean different things in the guide's home region. Correcting the misunderstanding requires challenging the guide before clients who have already dismissed local advice.

wd-p-0681|route|realist,adventure|A relief cyclist reaches a locked gate at the edge of an evacuated town. The supplied key fits the old lock displayed in a nearby notice, and the current lock was installed by the agency that issued the key.

wd-p-0682|resources|speculative,adventure|A settlement's emergency transport runs on a shared energy cell. Using it to evacuate the first group would shut down the beacon guiding the second group across the dark terrain outside.

wd-p-0683|coordination|realist,adventure|A river rescue team hears a whistle pattern meaning both stop and come closer under two training standards. The person in danger was trained under one, and the rescuer approaching her knows only the other.

wd-p-0684|threshold|realist,adventure|A mountain shelter's emergency door opens outward into snow. Digging it free requires sending someone through a ventilation shaft too narrow for the clothing needed to survive outside for long.

wd-p-0685|repair|speculative,adventure|A vehicle stranded on an ice moon can melt a path using its reactor exhaust. The path refreezes behind it, and a trailing rescue sled cannot match the speed required to stay in the warm channel.

wd-p-0686|trust|realist,adventure|A tour leader finds that a client's medical emergency was described inaccurately on the booking form. The client feared exclusion, and the leader must now ask for the truth without making that fear seem justified.

wd-p-0687|route|realist,adventure|A missing fisher's boat is found tied to a marker that drifts with the current. The search must reconstruct where it was anchored earlier, but the person who moved the marker insists the boat was never there.

wd-p-0688|resources|realist,adventure|A flooded campsite has enough floating equipment to evacuate everyone if it is shared. The owners have each packed private essentials inside, and redistributing the load means revealing needs some travelers have kept hidden.

wd-p-0689|coordination|speculative,adventure|A rescue station receives a distress call that repeats its own instructions before they are spoken. Following the apparent prediction could save time, but one repeated order is a mistake the controller has already decided to correct.

wd-p-0690|threshold|realist,adventure|A guide reaches a bridge with a weight limit that permits the party if their packs are carried separately. The far bank has no secure place to wait, and every extra crossing increases exposure to rising water.

wd-p-0691|repair|realist,adventure|A stranded mechanic can fix a radio using wire from a perimeter alarm. Removing it would silence the only warning of debris moving toward the camp while everyone concentrates on the repair.

wd-p-0692|trust|speculative,adventure|A navigation machine offers a route safe for every crew member listed on its manifest. The stowaway it does not know about has the one physical limitation that makes the recommended passage impossible.

wd-p-0693|route|realist,adventure|A rescue runner follows a trail maintained by a person who has recently lost sight. The trail remains navigable by touch, but the runner must abandon the visual markers used in the official search plan.

wd-p-0694|resources|realist,adventure|A boat crew must choose which cargo to jettison during a storm. The lightest-looking crate contains emergency flotation, and the person who packed it is unconscious before anyone can explain the inventory shorthand.

wd-p-0695|coordination|speculative,adventure|Two stranded habitats can exchange oxygen only by linking their systems. Their pressure standards differ, and a direct connection would trigger both automatic contamination barriers before either crew receives air.

wd-p-0696|threshold|realist,adventure|A relief driver reaches a road marked closed by an old sign and open by a fresh digital notice. The sign describes a structural limit, while the notice records only that debris has been removed.

wd-p-0697|repair|realist,adventure|A storm damages the only footbridge between a village and its clinic. Rebuilding quickly requires dismantling a ceremonial platform due to be used that night by the people most reluctant to surrender it.

wd-p-0698|trust|realist,adventure|A searcher finds a note saying the missing party has returned safely. The handwriting is genuine, but the note uses the name of a meeting point that moved after the writer left.

wd-p-0699|route|speculative,adventure|A caravan's protective field covers only a straight line between its lead and rear vehicles. A sharp turn around new debris would expose the middle travelers unless someone leaves the convoy to move the obstruction.

wd-p-0700|resources|realist,adventure|A rescue team reaches survivors with supplies sized for the original passenger list. One passenger has taken in a stranger since the accident, and admitting the extra person changes which evacuation plan is physically possible.

wd-p-0701|coordination|realist,adventure|A cliff rescue requires a signal from a boat below before the rope is lowered. Fog hides the boat, and the agreed radio channel is occupied by a second emergency whose responders believe they have exclusive use.
